svg.title: Downunder Voices Cartoon of the Day — The new airport’s first big arrival: the heat
svg.desc: Pen-and-ink editorial cartoon of a sun-baked western Sydney backyard. Beyond a timber paling fence, a new airport terminal, control tower and hangar shimmer in the heat as an airliner climbs past a blazing sun, and an airport arrivals board reads: Summer, on time; Heatwave, early; Cool change, delayed. In the yard a fictional woman in a sun hat and sundress sprays a garden hose over a fictional man in a singlet sitting in a camp chair with his feet in a children’s paddling pool, fanning himself with a folded newspaper and holding a cold drink. A dog pants in the shade of a gum tree, a thermometer on the fence reads 46 degrees, and an esky and a pair of thongs sit on the dry lawn. The woman says: We asked for more flights — not more degrees! Caption: The new airport’s first big arrival? The heat.
svg.text: DOWNUNDER VOICES — CARTOON OF THE DAY
THE NEW AIRPORT’S FIRST BIG ARRIVAL? THE HEAT.
Source: ABC News, 16 November 2026 — Concern that Western Sydney’s new airport could act as a summer “heat sink” for nearby homes.
